payload.rationale: Without specific information on the 2026 MLB season standings, starting pitchers, or which team is the home team (though 'Milwaukee vs Baltimore' often implies Baltimore is home in standard US notation), we must rely on historical MLB base rates. MLB games are generally close to a 50/50 proposition, with a slight edge to the home team (typically winning ~53-54% of the time). Assuming Milwaukee is the away team, their baseline win probability would be around 46-48%. Without further evidence, a near-even probability is the most reasonable estimate. Strongest reason this estimate could be too high: Baltimore might be a significantly stronger team in 2026 or have their ace pitcher starting, dropping Milwaukee's chances well below 50%. Strongest reason it could be too low: Milwaukee might be a dominant team in 2026, or they might actually be the home team, which would increase their win probability.
limitations: Lack of 2026 MLB standings, starting pitchers, and injury reports.
Uncertainty regarding which team is the home team.
